dedupe_keys.name: south korean manufacturing factories electricity consumption and demand response participation 2019

description: This figshare dataset releases electricity consumption of ten South Korean manufacturing factories that take part in the national demand response market. The data, in kilowatts, are each factory's total power use recorded by advanced metering infrastructure at one-minute intervals from 1 March to 30 September 2019. They also give the type of manufacturing, the dates of demand response events, each factory's mandatory reduction capacity and its actual response. The ten companies were chosen to represent different process regularity and company size. Version 9 was published on 27 February 2022 by Eunjung Lee, Keon Baek and Jinho Kim under CC BY 4.0, with a data archive of about 11 MB and a small code archive; access is free. Caveats: ten factories are a small sample, factory names are not given on the page read, and seven months of one year do not capture seasonal extremes. For simulation it provides real minute-level industrial load shapes and demand response behaviour to parameterise industrial flexibility in power system and virtual power plant models, and to test how factory load reacts during grid emergencies. Related catalogue records include the industrial load profiles of 5,359 companies, the steel plant load dataset and the NREL industrial facility combustion energy use data.
